compiled_state.title: S5.T3: RED test \xe2\x80\x94 verify-session-provenance.sh recognizes version-bump trailer on source-branch bump commit
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: Bump commit's trailer must be recognized by verify-session-provenance.sh so S3's integration-review skip continues to function. (Without this, S3 would flag the bump as unprovenanced and re-fire integration review.)

## Implementation Notes

Extend `tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh` (the same test file extended by S1.T4) with a fixture commit body:

```
chore(version): bump to 1.18.0

DSO-Story-Merge: 0c55-1103-a14d-431e
```

**Test approach**: Given a fixture commit with this body in the test range; When verify-session-provenance.sh runs over the range; Then exit code 0 (commit is provenanced).

Also test a fixture with `DSO-Story:` (no -Merge) form — should also pass exit 0 once S1.T5 lands.

The test must fail RED on the current verify-session-provenance.sh (before S1.T5 lands). However, S5's T3 SHOULD become GREEN automatically once S1.T5 (the verifier grep extension) lands; this test is a regression-protection assertion.

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_verify_session_provenance_version_bump_trailer]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh`.

**Dependency note**: this test's GREEN state depends on S1.T5 having landed. T3 can be queued for execution but only flips GREEN after S1.T5 merges to the session branch. The story-level dependency on S1 (depends_on link) covers this ordering.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh` | modify | (this IS the test) | needs-modification |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Test asserts both DSO-Story: and DSO-Story-Merge: forms on version-bump commits
  Verify: grep -qE 'chore.*version|version.*bump.*trailer' tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] Test passes GREEN against the post-S1.T5 + post-S5.T2 state
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated then cleared after S1.T5 lands
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_verify_session_provenance_version_bump_trailer\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
